# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **Consistent portal engagement** — The portal averages ~120 daily visitors with 7-minute sessions over the trailing 7 months, with no significant traffic drops outside a seasonal December dip to 92 daily visitors. [→ §portal]
2. **Referral links drive 61% of all portal traffic** — Search and social contribute less than 1% combined over the trailing 7 months, indicating an untapped opportunity to drive portal discoverability through search-engine optimization or shareable catalog links. [→ §portal]
3. **Portal geography mirrors ordering geography** — Texas, North Carolina, and Georgia lead both portal visitor counts and eCat order volume over the trailing 7 months, confirming that portal traffic is concentrated in active buying markets. [→ §portal]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Search and social channels represent untapped portal discovery paths; investing in basic SEO or catalog-sharing functionality could expand buyer reach beyond existing referral networks. [→ §portal]
